headline: Jury Note in Lil Durk Trial Sparks Legal Drama
body: A jury in Lil Durk's trial sent a note to the court stating they need more answers before a verdict. The note, shared by DJ Akademiks on Instagram, highlights jurors' concerns about insufficient evidence to convict. Judge CANNOT provide answers, leaving the case in limbo. This development adds tension to the high-profile legal battle.
